description: Show the launch page at the business's own subdomain, like join.yourbusiness.com (never a bare domain like yourbusiness.com). One address per workspace. Ask the person first and pass confirm: true after their yes. Returns the one CNAME record they add at their DNS host and the status (waiting_dns, securing, live, error). Their DNS is theirs: never ask for a DNS login. Returns not_available while the feature is off. Requires API key scope: draft.

confirm.description: true only after the person approved using this address.

name: launchpad_domain_set
title: Set launch page address
